sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and form provider
sections.what: Brings in the form library, label, slot, and style helpers. Sets the form provider to the library provider so the form state is shared.
sections.why: Likely reason: connects these parts to the form library's state.

sections.name: FormFieldContextValue
sections.title: Field name context
sections.what: Defines the type and shared context that carry a field's name down to the parts that need it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the parts inside a field know which field they belong to without being told each time.

sections.name: FormField
sections.title: Form field wrapper
sections.what: Wraps one field so it gets the field name and the form library controller. This is where a single input is connected to the form.
sections.why: Likely reason: connects each input to its validation state.

sections.name: useFormField
sections.title: Hook that reads field state
sections.what: A helper that reads the current error and state for the field, and builds the ids used to link the label, input, description, and message. It throws a clear error if used in the wrong place.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives every part one shared source of truth for the field's state and ids.
sections.watch_out: It must be used inside both a field wrapper and an item wrapper, or the screen will fail.

sections.name: FormItemContextValue (part 1)
sections.title: Item wrapper, label, and input link
sections.what: The item wrapper creates a unique id for the field group. The label, and the input wrapper that links to it, use that id to connect. The input also gets error and description links, and is marked invalid when there is an error.
sections.why: Likely reason: screen readers and clicks on the label need the link to work.
sections.watch_out: The unique id comes from the item wrapper, so a label outside its item will not link correctly.

sections.name: FormItemContextValue (part 2)
sections.title: Description, error message, and exports
sections.what: The description shows helper text. The message shows the error text in red, or the children if no error. It shows nothing when there is no text. The final list makes the parts available to other files.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows guidance and validation errors next to the input.
sections.watch_out: The message returns nothing when there is no text, so an error with an empty message is hidden.

summary: Connects the form library to the visual field parts so each label, input, description, and error message is linked to the right field and read correctly by screen readers.
purpose: Lets forms show validation errors and mark fields as invalid, using the shared field look. Screens build forms with these parts.
why: Likely reason: the form library tracks values and errors, and these wrappers pass that state to the visible parts. The code does not state this directly.
how: It sets the form provider to the library provider and keeps the name of each field in a shared context. The field wrapper hands that name down to the parts below it. A hook reads the current error state and builds linked element ids. The item wrapper generates a unique id, and the label, control, description, and message use it. The message shows the error text or any children it is given. Everything is exported.
inputs: Form state from the form library, the field name, and children such as inputs, labels, and text.
outputs: Linked form parts that show labels, error styling, descriptions, and error messages. Nothing is stored.
risks: The hook throws an error if used outside a field wrapper or item wrapper, which would crash that screen. Using ids from a different item can link the wrong label to an input.
debug: If you see an error about the hook being used outside a wrapper, check that the part sits inside a field and an item. If a label does not link to its input, check the id values and their use. If an error does not show, check the form library state for that field name.
